answer_1.quote: we propose to tackle ASQP in a sequence-to-sequence (S2S) manner in this paper.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates natural language sentences that linearize the sentiment quads, such as "Food quality is bad because pasta is over-cooked".

answer_2.quote: We employ F1 scores as the main evaluation metrics. A sentiment quad prediction is counted as correct if and only if all the predicted elements are exactly the same as the gold labels. We also report the precision (Pre) and recall (Rec) scores for the ASQP task.
